0022600093.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Clippers host the Sacramento Kings, and neither has played a game yet this season. The Clippers will be without Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), Max Strus (foot), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery), while Kobe Sanders (hip) and Kris Dunn (rest) are day-to-day and will be game-time decisions. The Kings are missing Dylan Cardwell (calf strain) and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee), and the Clippers won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 138-109 win in Sacramento on April 5, 2026. ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Clippers a 65% chance of winning.
